comparison.objective: Store a pH electrode in storage solution rather than deionized water; candidate removes HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Probe handling and correct-liquid insertion versus rigid-tool alignment, hammer impact and fragment retrieval.
comparison.success_condition: Electrode ends in the designated storage solution, not DI water; detailed thresholds are absent. Candidate requires four damage-free fractures and recovered fragments.
comparison.reason: Liquid-specific storage does not test impact fracture or protection of a retained insert.
